content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline.**

Section 20 of the Silverline agreement satisfies every preferred INDEMN element:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Express duty to defend Customer + affiliates | 20.1 ("defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates...") |
| Vendor indemnity vs. third-party claims | 20.1 / 20.2 |
| IP infringement by Services or Deliverables | 20.1 |
| Vendor's breach of applicable law | 20.2 |
| Data breach caused by Vendor | 20.2 ("unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor") |
| Gross negligence / wilful misconduct | 20.2 (plus fraud) |
| Notice / control / cooperation | 20.4 |
| Customer indemnity narrow | 20.3 (unmodified Customer-supplied material + Customer's own legal violations, with Vendor-side carve-outs) |

Additional Customer-favourable features noted (not required): 20.5 provides procure/modify/replace and refund remedies plus a bar on terminating unaffected Services, and 21.3 places indemnification obligations outside the liability cap — better than the fallback's 3× super-cap, so no upgrade or amendment is warranted.
